ev.q: A multistate outbreak of Listeria monocytogenes infections with 46 culture-confirmed cases, seven deaths, and three stillbirths or miscarriages in eight states
Cases have been reported from Pennsylvania (14 cases), New York (11 in New York City and seven in other locations)
Culture dates ranged from July 18 to September 30, 2002; case-finding is ongoing.
A multistate outbreak of Listeria monocytogenes infections with 46 culture-confirmed cases
